div.div: 5 تعمّج ; (S, O, K;) and ↓ عَمَجَ , (K,) inf. n. عَمْجٌ; (O;) He wound, or bent, (S, O, K,) in going along, (S, O,) or in the road, to the right and left: (K:) or فِى سَيْرِهِ ↓ عَمَجَ signifies he proceeded in every direction, by reason of briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness. (TA.) And تعمّجت الحَيَّةُ The serpent wound about in its course. (S, O.) And تعمّج السَّيْلُ فِى الوَادِى The torrent wound in the valley to the right and left. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
